summary: Eight compute-bound experiments completed in 74.6 wall-time minutes (averaging 9 minutes per experiment) based on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction. Execution was dominated by 'Challenge source features and missing-label loss with evaluator isolation' at 35.0 minutes and 'Repair the frozen training check and qualify reusable update mechanics' at 16.97 minutes, which together accounted for 51.97 minutes (69.7% of the milestone wall time). The post-execution GPU monitor report recorded both RTX 3090 GPUs idle (5MB and 4MB allocated at 0% utilization) upon completion with gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks recorded as false, while continuous active-window accelerator telemetry was unrecorded and no multi-model task requiring DualGPURunner was present.
bottlenecks_identified: The top two compute-bound experiments ('Challenge source features and missing-label loss with evaluator isolation' at 35.0 minutes and 'Repair the frozen training check and qualify reusable update mechanics' at 16.97 minutes) accounted for 51.97 of 74.6 total wall-time minutes (69.7%), but available records lack intra-task phase breakdown to isolate specific execution delays.
Milestone timing relied on disk-mtime fallback reconstruction because the live git-log path found 0 commits, omitting granular per-phase boundary markers and execution metadata.

The GPU monitor report provides only a single post-execution snapshot (both RTX 3090 GPUs idle at 0% utilization with 5MB and 4MB allocated at 2026-09-28T21:32:27.959482+00:00), leaving continuous accelerator utilization and throughput unmeasured across the 74.6 minutes.
improvements_suggested: Add granular phase-level timing within evaluator isolation and training qualification tasks to profile where execution time is concentrated.
Persist structured execution receipts at milestone boundaries to avoid falling back to disk-mtime reconstruction.
Sample GPU utilization, memory usage, and temperature periodically throughout task execution to capture active-window accelerator telemetry.
Include explicit concurrency and model count declarations in task manifests to unambiguously verify DualGPURunner applicability.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Implement intra-task phase profiling for the longest-running evaluator isolation and training check workflows to identify internal bottlenecks.
Persist structured milestone execution receipts to eliminate disk-mtime fallback reconstruction when git log yields 0 commits.
Deploy lightweight continuous GPU telemetry logging during compute-bound runs to measure active accelerator utilization.
meta_reflection: The GPU monitor report captured quiescent accelerators (both RTX 3090 GPUs at 0% utilization with 5MB and 4MB allocated) at milestone completion timestamp 2026-09-28T21:32:27.959482+00:00, indicating post-run idle state rather than mid-task stalling, consistent with gpu_idle_on_compute_bound_tasks=false. Without continuous active-window telemetry or intra-task phase timers for the 35.0-minute evaluator isolation and 16.97-minute training qualification tasks, specific internal compute bottlenecks cannot be definitively isolated from available records. Estimated time savings are set to 0% pending empirical measurement of phase profiling and receipt persistence tooling improvements.
